title: The press's verdict is good.
paragraphs: The verdict of defamation against the journalist Highlight Kalimantan, Good Faithful Minister, has been read: The defendant has been convicted of attempted crimes.

According to the indictment, the Good Faithful Witness published a story about the quality of the school building on March 14, 2026, which the prosecutor accused a certain act of damaging a person's good name, which was used: section 310 KUHP.
The Court of Justice Banjarmasin reads the verdict on June 30, 2026.
In the good case of the Faithful, the lawman Dedi Gunwan referred to it as being convicted without asking the expert opinion of the Press Council.
The Administrator works as a reporter at Banjarmasin, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The prosecutor and the defendant can still appeal.
